== Title ==
<span lang="ja">U-3PO (ユー・スリーピオ)</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">敵の側に潜伏中のスパイとして配備する。通常のスパイと異なり、位置カードでの戦闘中には、U-3PO戦闘力をライトサイドの合計に加える。スパイが"正体を現す"こととなったら、上記のカードルールはキャンセルされ、ライトサイドはこのドロイドを"盗んだ"場合と同様に使用できる。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">オルデランの外交団に仕えていた通訳ドロイド。帝国軍がプログラムを改変し、諜報活動に使っていた。ドロイドは自分でも知らぬ間に帝国軍のスパイとなっていたのだ。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio)]].

'''Lore''' — This protocol droid served Alderaan's diplomatic corps. The Empire altered its programming and used it for espionage. The droid became an Imperial spy without even knowing it.

'''Game text''' — Deploy on the opponent's side as an undercover spy. Unlike ordinary spies, during battle at a location card, add U-3PO's power to the Light Side total. If the spy's identity is revealed, the above card rules are canceled, and the Light Side may use this droid as if stolen.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The Japanese face uses the Light Side character template. The English original is Dark Side. Japanese says unlike ordinary spies and adds power at a location card. English says except that if present during a battle at a site. Japanese cancels the above card rules. English cancels the above game text.<ref>[[:File:ANH-D-u3po-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[U-3PO (Yoo-Threepio)]].</ref>
